title: Koska Reeves
description: Mandalorian Koska Reeves was a member of Bo-Katan Kryze's Nite Owls. On Trask, she and her allies saved Din Djarin and Grogu from Quarren pirates. Djarin helped Kryze's team raid and steal an Imperial cruiser. Later, Djarin approached Kryze and Reeves for aid in rescuing Grogu. Reeves fought alongside Kryze, Fennec Shand and Cara Dune.
